{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"This is a list of winners of the Academy Award of Merit for Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role, presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) to an actor who has delivered an outstanding performance while working within the film industry.","title":"List of Best Supporting Actor winners by age"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" More popularly known as the Academy Award (or the Oscar) for Best Supporting Actor, this award was initially presented at the 9th Academy Awards ceremony for 1936 and was most recently presented at the 88th Academy Awards ceremony for 2015.","title":"List of Best Supporting Actor winners by age"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Throughout the past 80 years, accounting for ties and repeat winners, AMPAS has presented a total of 81 Best Supporting Actor awards to 73 different actors.","title":"List of Best Supporting Actor winners by age"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" This list is current as of the 89th Academy Awards ceremony held on February 26, 2017.","title":"List of Best Supporting Actor winners by age"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Akim Mikhailovich Tamiroff (Armenian: Ակիմ Թամիրով , Russian: Аким Михайлович Тамиров ; birth name` Hovakim, Armenian: Հովակիմ ; 29 October 1899 – 17 September 1972) was an ethnic Armenian actor.","title":"Akim Tamiroff"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" He won the first Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor, was nominated twice for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, and appeared in at least 80 American motion pictures in a career spanning thirty-seven years.","title":"Akim Tamiroff"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Name the actor who has acted in the film Arrival and who has been nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for the film `The Town' ?"}
